cases.question: If I wanted to solve a physical Rubik's cube multiple times, for practice, what is the best, most random way, to scramble the solved cube? The best way I can think is to hold it behind my back and turn randomly until, when I look at it, it looks random enough. Is there a better way?
cases.expected: Recommend generating a random reachable state and applying a generated scramble to the solved cube (or using a recognized random-state 3x3 generator); distinguish from eyeballed or fixed-length hand turns.

cases.question: 我怎样才能获得 WCA ID 和 WCA 个人成绩页？
cases.expected: Both created after first official competition results are published; registering an account alone is insufficient.

cases.question: Why is a single-corner twist not a valid position on a Rubik's cube?
cases.expected: Explain signed corner twist sum modulo 3 is invariant under every legal face turn, initially zero, and one twist violates it.

cases.question: 我该怎么报名参加比赛？如果报名遇到问题，可以联系谁？
cases.expected: Use the named competition registration page/instructions or the listed external system, and contact its organizers for problems.

cases.question: What is the Official notation on rubik's revenge(4x4)?
cases.expected: Give correct official 4x4 outer and two-layer wide notation (R and Rw/2Rw), note r can vary between unofficial conventions. No incorrect WCA rule about lowercase being official inner layer.

cases.question: 我的魔方掉了一枚中心盖或一个部件，还能用它参赛吗？
cases.expected: The FAQ disallows competing with this damaged/distinguishable puzzle; a correct repair/replacement before use is acceptable. Do not conflate with in-solve puzzle defects.

cases.question: Why does the 4x4 Rubik's cube have parity cases, while the 3x3 does not?
cases.expected: Explain paired 4x4 wings and interchangeable centers/reduction conceal permutations. Account for apparent one edge flip (wing exchange/orientation) and two paired-edge swap, which violate 3x3 constraints but are possible on 4x4.
